entities.summary: Brendan Austin Rodgers is an American professional baseball second baseman in the Boston Red Sox organization. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Colorado Rockies and Houston Astros. He was drafted third overall by the Rockies in the 2015 MLB draft.
